title: LDAP: Disect MS-CLDAP NextClosestSiteName
description:
Dissect NextClosestSiteName. Remove an unnecessary "if (tree)" statement
so that the offset is still advanced properlyi when the sockaddr_in
structure is sent along with NextClosestSiteName. Advance the offset for
the undissected reserved sin_zero field (8 bytes) in that case as well.

See MS-ADTS 6.3.1.9
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-adts/

Fix #20448
